# The White House

> The official website of the President of the United States, publishing presidential actions, policy materials, news, and administration information.

The White House website serves as the central source for official statements, executive orders, proclamations, fact sheets, briefings, and information about the President, Vice President, administration priorities, and the Executive Office of the President.

## Main Site
- [The White House](https://www.whitehouse.gov/): Homepage for official White House news, priorities, and presidential updates.
- [Administration](https://www.whitehouse.gov/administration/): Profiles and information for the President, Vice President, and senior leadership.
- [Issues](https://www.whitehouse.gov/issues/): Policy priority hub covering major domestic and foreign policy topics.
- [News](https://www.whitehouse.gov/news/): Central news index for statements, releases, and official updates.
- [Presidential Actions](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/): Official repository for executive orders, proclamations, and memoranda.
- [Remarks](https://www.whitehouse.gov/remarks/): Speeches, public remarks, and prepared presidential statements.
- [Briefing Room](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/): Aggregated access to news, statements, and presidential materials.
- [Contact](https://www.whitehouse.gov/contact/): Public contact information and message submission to the White House.

## Administration
- [President Donald J. Trump](https://www.whitehouse.gov/administration/president-donald-j-trump/): Biography and official profile of the President.
- [Vice President JD Vance](https://www.whitehouse.gov/administration/vice-president-jd-vance/): Biography and official profile of the Vice President.
- [First Lady Melania Trump](https://www.whitehouse.gov/administration/first-lady-melania-trump/): Biography and initiatives of the First Lady.
- [Second Lady Usha Vance](https://www.whitehouse.gov/administration/second-lady-usha-vance/): Biography and official profile of the Second Lady.
- [Cabinet](https://www.whitehouse.gov/administration/cabinet/): Overview of Cabinet members and executive branch leadership.
- [Executive Office of the President](https://www.whitehouse.gov/administration/executive-office-of-the-president/): Information on White House offices and policy councils.

## Presidential Actions
- [Presidential Actions](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/): Index of executive actions issued by the President.
- [Executive Orders](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/executive-orders/): Collection of executive orders published by the White House.
- [Presidential Memoranda](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/presidential-memoranda/): Presidential memoranda on administration and policy matters.
- [Proclamations](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/proclamations/): Presidential proclamations for observances, policy, and legal actions.
- [Nominations & Appointments](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/nominations-and-appointments/): Announcements of nominations, appointments, and related personnel actions.

## Briefing Room
- [Briefing Room](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/): Main index for White House releases, statements, and transcripts.
- [Statements and Releases](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/statements-releases/): Official statements, announcements, and release materials.
- [Remarks](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/speeches-remarks/): Speeches and remarks from the President and senior officials.
- [Press Briefings](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/press-briefings/): Press briefing transcripts and media-facing updates.
- [Presidential Actions](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/presidential-actions/): Briefing Room view of executive orders and related actions.
- [Legislation](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/legislation/): Statements and messages related to legislation and congressional action.
- [Disclosures](https://www.whitehouse.gov/disclosures/): Financial disclosures and ethics-related public documents.

## News and Media
- [News](https://www.whitehouse.gov/news/): White House news landing page for current administration updates.
- [Articles](https://www.whitehouse.gov/articles/): Longer-form White House articles and explanatory posts.
- [Fact Sheets](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/): Policy fact sheets summarizing administration actions and priorities.
- [Live](https://www.whitehouse.gov/live/): Live video streams and event coverage from the White House.
- [Gallery](https://www.whitehouse.gov/gallery/): Official photos and visual media from White House events.
- [Videos](https://www.whitehouse.gov/video/): Video archive of speeches, events, and official productions.

## Issues and Policy
- [Issues](https://www.whitehouse.gov/issues/): Overview of the administration’s major policy issue areas.
- [The Economy](https://www.whitehouse.gov/issues/economy/): Materials on jobs, inflation, trade, taxes, and economic policy.
- [Immigration](https://www.whitehouse.gov/issues/immigration/): Policies and actions related to border security and immigration.
- [National Security & Defense](https://www.whitehouse.gov/issues/national-security-defense/): National security, military, and defense policy resources.
- [Foreign Policy](https://www.whitehouse.gov/issues/foreign-policy/): International relations, diplomacy, and global strategy materials.
- [Energy & Environment](https://www.whitehouse.gov/issues/energy-environment/): Energy production, regulation, and environmental policy information.
- [Education](https://www.whitehouse.gov/issues/education/): Education policy priorities and related administration actions.
- [Healthcare](https://www.whitehouse.gov/issues/healthcare/): Healthcare policy information, reforms, and public health priorities.

## Participation and Public Access
- [Contact](https://www.whitehouse.gov/contact/): Send messages or inquiries to the White House.
- [Get Involved](https://www.whitehouse.gov/get-involved/): Public engagement opportunities and participation resources.
- [Tours & Events](https://www.whitehouse.gov/visit/): Information about visiting the White House and public tours.
- [Internships](https://www.whitehouse.gov/get-involved/internships/): White House internship program information and application details.
- [Fellows Program](https://www.whitehouse.gov/get-involved/white-house-fellows/): Information on the White House Fellows leadership program.
- [Presidential Personnel Office](https://www.whitehouse.gov/get-involved/presidential-personnel-office/): Information on service opportunities in the administration.

## History and Government
- [About The White House](https://www.whitehouse.gov/about-the-white-house/): Background on the White House, its role, and its history.
- [Our Government](https://www.whitehouse.gov/about-the-white-house/our-government/): Overview of the federal government and constitutional structure.
- [The Presidents](https://www.whitehouse.gov/about-the-white-house/presidents/): Historical information about U.S. presidents.
- [The White House Grounds](https://www.whitehouse.gov/about-the-white-house/the-white-house/): Information about the White House residence and grounds.
- [The Cabinet](https://www.whitehouse.gov/about-the-white-house/our-government/the-cabinet/): Historical and structural overview of the Cabinet.
- [The Executive Office of the President](https://www.whitehouse.gov/about-the-white-house/our-government/the-executive-office-of-the-president/): Explanation of the EOP and its component offices.

## Information and Legal
- [Disclosures](https://www.whitehouse.gov/disclosures/): Public financial disclosure and related transparency documents.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.whitehouse.gov/privacy/): Privacy practices for WhiteHouse.gov visitors and submissions.
- [Copyright Policy](https://www.whitehouse.gov/copyright/): Copyright and reuse terms for White House website content.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://www.whitehouse.gov/accessibility/): Accessibility commitment and support information for the site.
- [FOIA](https://www.whitehouse.gov/foia/): Freedom of Information Act guidance and related information.
- [Open Government](https://www.whitehouse.gov/open/): Open government and transparency resources.
